data.navTitle: 几何滑板、折线图与两条平行线
data.title: Shapes on a sliding board
data.situation:
The next board had shapes that slid along short tracks. Maya lined up two straight edges to make a right angle. Jo placed a pentagon beside a hexagon and counted their sides. Below them, an ellipse could turn without becoming a circle; its label described the outline as elliptical. A mirror down the middle of another figure revealed its symmetry. Jo checked whether the two halves were symmetric. At the bottom, two parallels ran across the board without meeting. They stayed on their tracks while a child shifted the nearby shapes. Jo: Does this angle change when I turn the whole shape?
Maya: The angle between the edges stays the same.
Jo: This one has five sides.
Maya: Then put it beside the six-sided one, so we can compare them.

readingBlocks.en: The next board had shapes that slid along short tracks. Maya lined up two straight edges to make a right angle. Jo placed a pentagon beside a hexagon and counted their sides. Below them, an ellipse could turn without becoming a circle; its label described the outline as elliptical. A mirror down the middle of another figure revealed its symmetry. Jo checked whether the two halves were symmetric. At the bottom, two parallels ran across the board without meeting. They stayed on their tracks while a child shifted the nearby shapes.
readingBlocks.zh: 下一块板上的形状可沿短轨道滑动。玛雅把两条直边对成直角。乔把五边形放在六边形旁，数它们的边。下方的椭圆转动后仍不是圆，标签把轮廓称为椭圆形。另一图形中间的镜面展示对称性，乔检查两半是否对称。底部两条平行线横过板而不相交。孩子移动旁边形状时，它们仍在轨道上。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Does this angle change when I turn the whole shape?
Maya: The angle between the edges stays the same.
Jo: This one has five sides.
Maya: Then put it beside the six-sided one, so we can compare them.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：转动整个形状时，这个角变了吗？
玛雅：两边之间的角仍一样。
乔：这个有五条边。
玛雅：把它放在六条边的旁边，这样可以比较。

glossary.zh: 两条相交线或面之间的角
glossary.note: 几何中的角；a right angle 是直角。
glossary.example: The angle between the edges stayed the same.
glossary.exampleZh: 两边之间的角保持不变。

externalEvidence.definition: the space between two lines or planes that intersect; the inclination of one line to another; measured in degrees or radians

glossary.note: 名词 right angle；修饰名词时可写 right-angle，如 a right-angle bend。

externalEvidence.definition: the 90 degree angle between two perpendicular lines

glossary.zh: 有五条边的平面图形；五边形
glossary.note: 五条边构成的图形；小写 pentagon。
glossary.example: Jo counted the sides of the pentagon.

glossary.zh: 有六条边的平面图形；六边形
glossary.note: 六条边构成的图形，不一定是正六边形。
几何名词；形容词为 elliptical。
glossary.example: An ellipse turned on the board.

externalEvidence.definition: a closed plane curve resulting from the intersection of a circular cone and a plane cutting completely through it

glossary.note: 这里表示椭圆形的，如 an elliptical shape。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Geometry sense relating to ellipse; do not equate every egg shape with ellipse.

glossary.zh: 相应部分相互匹配的对称性
glossary.note: 镜像对称可说 a line of symmetry，对称轴。
glossary.example: The mirror revealed the figure’s symmetry.
glossary.exampleZh: 镜面展示图形的对称性。

externalEvidence.definition: (mathematics) an attribute of a shape or relation; exact reflection of form on opposite sides of a dividing line or plane

glossary.note: 对应部分对称；也常用 symmetrical。

externalEvidence.definition: having similarity in size, shape, and relative position of corresponding parts

glossary.zh: 与另一条线保持相等距离而不相交的平行线
glossary.note: 这里的 parallels 是平行线；更常说 parallel lines。
glossary.example: Two parallels ran across the board.

externalEvidence.definition: (mathematics) one of a set of parallel geometric figures (parallel lines or planes)
